what_happened: Research had already traced the uniq_tasks>=2 gate in build_contended_manifest to source, so the mechanism ruling needed no re-derivation at plan time; the plan could spend its budget on siting and uniformity instead. A plan-time re-grep of all fifteen file_scope entries confirmed the report's zero-count --task claim and additionally separated 21 genuine invocation sites from prose mentions, which let the phase split be drawn on real site counts rather than per-file guesses.
